verses.original: אָדָ֥ם שֵׁ֖ת אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḏām šêṯ ’ĕ·nō·wōš
verses.literal: Adam Seth Enosh
verses.literalPt: Adão, Sete, Enos,

verses.original: קֵינָ֥ן מַהֲלַלְאֵ֖ל יָֽרֶד׃
verses.transliteration: qê·nān ma·hă·lal·’êl yā·reḏ
verses.literal: Kenan Mahalalel Jared
verses.literalPt: Cainã, Maalaleel, Jarede,

verses.original: חֲנ֥וֹךְ מְתוּשֶׁ֖לַח לָֽמֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·nō·wḵ mə·ṯū·še·laḥ lā·meḵ
verses.literal: Enoch Methuselah Lamech, Noah
verses.literalPt: Enoque, Matusalém, Lameque,

verses.original: נֹ֥חַ שֵׁ֖ם חָ֥ם וָיָֽפֶת׃ס
verses.transliteration: nō·aḥ šêm ḥām wā·yā·p̄eṯ
verses.literal: The sons of Noah Shem Ham and Japheth
verses.literalPt: Noé, Sem, Cam e Jafé.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י יֶ֔פֶת גֹּ֣מֶר וּמָג֔וֹג וּמָדַ֖י וְיָוָ֣ן וְתֻבָ֑ל וּמֶ֖שֶׁךְ וְתִירָֽס׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ye·p̄eṯ gō·mer ū·mā·ḡō·wḡ ū·mā·ḏay wə·yā·wān wə·ṯu·ḇāl ū·me·šeḵ wə·ṯî·rās
verses.literal: The sons of Japheth Gomer Magog Madai Javan Tubal Meshech and Tiras
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Jafé: Gômer, Magogue, Madai, Javã, Tubal, Meseque e Tirás.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֖י גֹּ֑מֶר אַשְׁכֲּנַ֥ז וְדִיפַ֖ת וְתוֹגַרְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê gō·mer ’aš·kă·naz wə·ḏî·p̄aṯ wə·ṯō·w·ḡar·māh
verses.literal: The sons of Gomer Ashkenaz Riphath and Togarmah
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Gômer: Asquenaz, Difate e Togarma.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י יָוָ֖ן אֱלִישָׁ֣ה וְתַרְשִׁ֑ישָׁה כִּתִּ֖ים וְרוֹדָנִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yā·wān ’ĕ·lî·šāh wə·ṯar·šî·šāh kit·tîm wə·rō·w·ḏā·nîm
verses.literal: And the sons of Javan Elishah Tarshish the Kittites and the Rodanites
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Javã: Elisá, Társis, Quitim e Rodanim.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י חָ֑ם כּ֥וּשׁ וּמִצְרַ֖יִם פּ֥וּט וּכְנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ḥām kūš ū·miṣ·ra·yim pūṭ ū·ḵə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: The sons of Ham Cush Mizraim Put and Canaan
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Cam: Cuxe, Mizraim, Pute e Canaã.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י כ֔וּשׁ סְבָא֙ וַחֲוִילָ֔ה וְסַבְתָּ֥א וְרַעְמָ֖א וְסַבְתְּכָ֑א וּבְנֵ֥י רַעְמָ֖א שְׁבָ֥א וּדְדָֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê ḵūš sə·ḇā wa·ḥă·wî·lāh wə·saḇ·tā wə·ra‘·mā wə·saḇ·tə·ḵā ū·ḇə·nê ra‘·mā šə·ḇā ū·ḏə·ḏān
verses.literal: The sons of Cush Seba Havilah Sabta Raamah and Sabteca The sons of Raamah Sheba and Dedan
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Cuxe: Sebá, Havilá, Sabtá, Raamá e Sabtecá. Os filhos de Raamá: Sebá e Dedã.

verses.original: וְכ֖וּשׁ יָלַ֣ד אֶת־ נִמְר֑וֹד ה֣וּא הֵחֵ֔ל לִהְי֥וֹת גִּבּ֖וֹר בָּאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵūš yā·laḏ ’eṯ- nim·rō·wḏ hū hê·ḥêl lih·yō·wṯ gib·bō·wr bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Cush was the father of Nimrod who began to be a mighty one on the earth
verses.literalPt: Cuxe gerou a Ninrode, que começou a ser poderoso na terra.

verses.original: וּמִצְרַ֡יִם יָלַ֞ד אֶת־ לוּדִיִּים וְאֶת־ עֲנָמִ֛ים וְאֶת־ לְהָבִ֖ים וְאֶת־ נַפְתֻּחִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·miṣ·ra·yim yā·laḏ ’eṯ- lū·ḏī·yīm wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·nā·mîm wə·’eṯ- lə·hā·ḇîm wə·’eṯ- nap̄·tu·ḥîm
verses.literal: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites the Anamites the Lehabites the Naphtuhites
verses.literalPt: Mizraim gerou a Ludim, a Ananim, a Leabim, a Naftuim,

verses.original: וְֽאֶת־ פַּתְרֻסִ֞ים וְאֶת־ כַּסְלֻחִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָצְא֥וּ מִשָּׁ֛ם פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְאֶת־ כַּפְתֹּרִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- paṯ·ru·sîm wə·’eṯ- kas·lu·ḥîm ’ă·šer yā·ṣə·’ū miš·šām pə·liš·tîm wə·’eṯ- kap̄·tō·rîm
verses.literal: the Pathrusites the Casluhites from whom the Philistines came and the Caphtorites
verses.literalPt: a Patrusim, a Casluim (donde procederam os filisteus) e a Caftorim.

verses.original: וּכְנַ֗עַן יָלַ֛ד אֶת־ צִיד֥וֹן בְּכֹר֖וֹ וְאֶת־ חֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḵə·na·‘an yā·laḏ ’eṯ- ṣî·ḏō·wn bə·ḵō·rōw wə·’eṯ- ḥêṯ
verses.literal: And Canaan was the father of Sidon his firstborn and of the Hittites
verses.literalPt: Canaã gerou a Sidom, seu primogênito, a Hete,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַיְבוּסִי֙ וְאֶת־ הָ֣אֱמֹרִ֔י וְאֵ֖ת הַגִּרְגָּשִֽׁי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hay·ḇū·sî wə·’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·’êṯ hag·gir·gā·šî
verses.literal: the Jebusites the Amorites the Girgashites
verses.literalPt: aos jebuseus, aos amorreus, aos girgaseus,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַחִוִּ֥י וְאֶת־ הַֽעַרְקִ֖י וְאֶת־ הַסִּינִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥiw·wî wə·’eṯ- ha·‘ar·qî wə·’eṯ- has·sî·nî
verses.literal: the Hivites the Arkites the Sinites
verses.literalPt: aos heveus, aos arqueus, aos sineus,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הָאַרְוָדִ֥י וְאֶת־ הַצְּמָרִ֖י וְאֶת־ הַֽחֲמָתִֽי׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hā·’ar·wā·ḏî wə·’eṯ- haṣ·ṣə·mā·rî wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥă·mā·ṯî
verses.literal: the Arvadites the Zemarites and the Hamathites
verses.literalPt: aos arvadeus, aos zemareus e aos hamateus.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שֵׁ֔ם עֵילָ֣ם וְאַשּׁ֔וּר וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד וְל֣וּד וַאֲרָ֑ם וְע֥וּץ וְח֖וּל וְגֶ֥תֶר וָמֶֽשֶׁךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê šêm ‘ê·lām wə·’aš·šūr wə·’ar·paḵ·šaḏ wə·lūḏ wa·’ă·rām wə·‘ūṣ wə·ḥūl wə·ḡe·ṯer wā·me·šeḵ
verses.literal:
The sons of Shem Elam Asshur Arphaxad Lud and Aram.

The sons of Aram: Uz Hul Gether and Meshech
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Sem: Elão, Assur, Arfaxade, Lude, Arão, Uz, Hul, Géter e Meseque.

verses.original: וְאַרְפַּכְשַׁ֖ד יָלַ֣ד אֶת־ שָׁ֑לַח וְשֶׁ֖לַח יָלַ֥ד אֶת־ עֵֽבֶר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ar·paḵ·šaḏ yā·laḏ ’eṯ- šā·laḥ wə·še·laḥ yā·laḏ ’eṯ- ‘ê·ḇer
verses.literal: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah and Shelah was the father of Eber
verses.literalPt: Arfaxade gerou a Selá, e Selá gerou a Héber.

verses.original: וּלְעֵ֥בֶר יֻלַּ֖ד שְׁנֵ֣י בָנִ֑ים שֵׁ֣ם הָאֶחָ֞ד פֶּ֗לֶג כִּ֤י בְיָמָיו֙ נִפְלְגָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ וְשֵׁ֥ם אָחִ֖יו יָקְטָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·‘ê·ḇer yul·laḏ šə·nê ḇā·nîm šêm hā·’e·ḥāḏ pe·leḡ kî ḇə·yā·māw nip̄·lə·ḡāh hā·’ā·reṣ wə·šêm ’ā·ḥîw yā·qə·ṭān
verses.literal: Two sons were born to Eber One was named Peleg because in his days the earth was divided and his brother was named Joktan
verses.literalPt: A Héber nasceram dois filhos, um dos quais foi chamado Pelegue, porque, nos seus dias, se dividiu a terra; e o nome de seu irmão foi Joctã.

verses.original: וְיָקְטָ֣ן יָלַ֔ד אֶת־ אַלְמוֹדָ֖ד וְאֶת־ שָׁ֑לֶף וְאֶת־ חֲצַרְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־ יָֽרַח׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·qə·ṭān yā·laḏ ’eṯ- ’al·mō·w·ḏāḏ wə·’eṯ- šā·lep̄ wə·’eṯ- ḥă·ṣar·mā·weṯ wə·’eṯ- yā·raḥ
verses.literal: And Joktan was the father of Almodad Sheleph Hazarmaveth Jerah
verses.literalPt: Joctã gerou a Almodade, a Salefe, a Hazar-Mavé, a Jerá,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הֲדוֹרָ֥ם וְאֶת־ אוּזָ֖ל וְאֶת־ דִּקְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- hă·ḏō·w·rām wə·’eṯ- ’ū·zāl wə·’eṯ- diq·lāh
verses.literal: Hadoram Uzal Diklah
verses.literalPt: a Hadorão, a Uzal, a Dicla,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ עֵיבָ֥ל וְאֶת־ אֲבִימָאֵ֖ל וְאֶת־ שְׁבָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ‘ê·ḇāl wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·mā·’êl wə·’eṯ- šə·ḇā
verses.literal: Obal Abimael Sheba
verses.literalPt: a Ebal, a Abimael, a Sabá,

verses.original: וְאֶת־ אוֹפִ֥יר וְאֶת־ חֲוִילָ֖ה וְאֶת־ יוֹבָ֑ב כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י יָקְטָֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ’ō·w·p̄îr wə·’eṯ- ḥă·wî·lāh wə·’eṯ- yō·w·ḇāḇ kāl- ’êl·leh bə·nê yā·qə·ṭān
verses.literal: Ophir Havilah and Jobab All these were sons of Joktan
verses.literalPt: a Ofir, a Havilá e a Jobabe. Todos estes eram filhos de Joctã.

verses.transliteration: šêm ’ar·paḵ·šaḏ šā·laḥ
verses.literal: So from Shem came Arphaxad Shelah
verses.literalPt: Sem, Arfaxade, Selá,

verses.original: עֵ֥בֶר פֶּ֖לֶג רְעֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·ḇer pe·leḡ rə·‘ū
verses.literal: Eber Peleg Reu
verses.literalPt: Héber, Pelegue, Reú,

verses.original: שְׂר֥וּג נָח֖וֹר תָּֽרַח׃
verses.transliteration: śə·rūḡ nā·ḥō·wr tā·raḥ
verses.literal: Serug Nahor Terah
verses.literalPt: Serugue, Naor, Tera,

verses.original: אַבְרָ֖ם ה֥וּא אַבְרָהָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’aḇ·rām hū ’aḇ·rā·hām
verses.literal: and Abram (that is Abraham
verses.literalPt: Abrão (Este é Abraão.).

verses.original: בְּנֵי֙ אַבְרָהָ֔ם יִצְחָ֖ק וְיִשְׁמָעֵֽאל׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ’aḇ·rā·hām yiṣ·ḥāq wə·yiš·mā·‘êl
verses.literal: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Abraão: Isaque e Ismael.

verses.original: אֵ֖לֶּה תֹּלְדוֹתָ֑ם בְּכ֤וֹר יִשְׁמָעֵאל֙ נְבָי֔וֹת וְקֵדָ֥ר וְאַדְבְּאֵ֖ל וּמִבְשָֽׂם׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh tō·lə·ḏō·w·ṯām bə·ḵō·wr yiš·mā·‘êl nə·ḇā·yō·wṯ wə·qê·ḏār wə·’aḏ·bə·’êl ū·miḇ·śām
verses.literal: These are their genealogies Nebaioth the firstborn of Ishmael then Kedar Adbeel Mibsam
verses.literalPt: Estas são as suas gerações: Nebaiote, primogênito de Ismael, depois Quedar, Adbeel, Mibsão,

verses.original: מִשְׁמָ֣ע וְדוּמָ֔ה מַשָּׂ֖א חֲדַ֥ד וְתֵימָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: miš·mā‘ wə·ḏū·māh maś·śā ḥă·ḏaḏ wə·ṯê·mā
verses.literal: Mishma Dumah Massa Hadad Tema
verses.literalPt: Misma, Dumá, Massá, Hadade, Tema,

verses.original: יְט֥וּר נָפִ֖ישׁ וָקֵ֑דְמָה אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׁמָעֵֽאל׃ס
verses.transliteration: yə·ṭūr nā·p̄îš wā·qê·ḏə·māh ’êl·leh hêm bə·nê yiš·mā·‘êl
verses.literal: Jetur Naphish and Kedemah These were the sons of Ishmael
verses.literalPt: Jetur, Nafis e Quedemá. Estes são os filhos de Ismael.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֨י קְטוּרָ֜ה פִּילֶ֣גֶשׁ אַבְרָהָ֗ם יָלְדָ֞ה אֶת־ זִמְרָ֧ן וְיָקְשָׁ֛ן וּמְדָ֥ן וּמִדְיָ֖ן וְיִשְׁבָּ֣ק וְשׁ֑וּחַ וּבְנֵ֥י יָקְשָׁ֖ן שְׁבָ֥א וּדְדָֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê qə·ṭū·rāh pî·le·ḡeš ’aḇ·rā·hām yā·lə·ḏāh ’eṯ- zim·rān wə·yā·qə·šān ū·mə·ḏān ū·miḏ·yān wə·yiš·bāq wə·šū·aḥ ū·ḇə·nê yā·qə·šān šə·ḇā ū·ḏə·ḏān
verses.literal: The sons born to Keturah Abraham’s concubine Zimran Jokshan Medan Midian Ishbak and Shuah The sons of Jokshan Sheba and Dedan
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Quetura, concubina de Abraão, que deu à luz Zinrã, Jocsã, Medã, Midiã, Jisbaque e Sua. Os filhos de Jocsã: Sabá e Dedã.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן עֵיפָ֤ה וָעֵ֙פֶר֙ וַחֲנ֔וֹךְ וַאֲבִידָ֖ע וְאֶלְדָּעָ֑ה כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י קְטוּרָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê miḏ·yān ‘ê·p̄āh wā·‘ê·p̄er wa·ḥă·nō·wḵ wa·’ă·ḇî·ḏā‘ wə·’el·dā·‘āh kāl- ’êl·leh bə·nê qə·ṭū·rāh
verses.literal: The sons of Midian Ephah Epher Hanoch Abida and Eldaah All of these were Keturah’s sons
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Midiã: Efá, Éfer, Enoque, Abida e Elda. Todos estes eram filhos de Quetura.

verses.original: וַיּ֥וֹלֶד אַבְרָהָ֖ם אֶת־ יִצְחָ֑קס בְּנֵ֣י יִצְחָ֔ק עֵשָׂ֖ו וְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·leḏ ’aḇ·rā·hām ’eṯ- yiṣ·ḥå̄·qs bə·nê yiṣ·ḥāq ‘ê·śāw wə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Abraham was the father of Isaac The sons of Isaac Esau and Israel
verses.literalPt: Abraão gerou a Isaque. Os filhos de Isaque: Esaú e Israel.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י עֵשָׂ֑ו אֱלִיפַ֛ז רְעוּאֵ֥ל וִיע֖וּשׁ וְיַעְלָ֥ם וְקֹֽרַח׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ‘ê·śāw ’ĕ·lî·p̄az rə·‘ū·’êl wî·‘ūš wə·ya‘·lām wə·qō·raḥ
verses.literal: The sons of Esau Eliphaz Reuel Jeush Jalam and Korah
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Esaú: Elifaz, Reuel, Jeús, Jalão e Coré.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י אֱלִיפָ֑ז תֵּימָ֤ן וְאוֹמָר֙ צְפִ֣י וְגַעְתָּ֔ם קְנַ֖ז וְתִמְנָ֥ע וַעֲמָלֵֽק׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ’ĕ·lî·p̄āz tê·mān wə·’ō·w·mār ṣə·p̄î wə·ḡa‘·tām qə·naz wə·ṯim·nā‘ wa·‘ă·mā·lêq
verses.literal: The sons of Eliphaz Teman Omar Zepho Gatam and Kenaz and by Timna Amalek
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Elifaz: Temã, Omar, Zefi, Gaetã, Quenaz, Timna e Amaleque.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֖י רְעוּאֵ֑ל נַ֥חַת זֶ֖רַח שַׁמָּ֥ה וּמִזָּֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê rə·‘ū·’êl na·ḥaṯ ze·raḥ šam·māh ū·miz·zāh
verses.literal: The sons of Reuel Nahath Zerah Shammah and Mizzah
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Reuel: Naate, Zerá, Samá e Mizá.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י שֵׂעִ֔יר לוֹטָ֥ן וְשׁוֹבָ֖ל וְצִבְע֣וֹן וַֽעֲנָ֑ה וְדִישֹׁ֥ן וְאֵ֖צֶר וְדִישָֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê śê·‘îr lō·w·ṭān wə·šō·w·ḇāl wə·ṣiḇ·‘ō·wn wa·‘ă·nāh wə·ḏî·šōn wə·’ê·ṣer wə·ḏî·šān
verses.literal: The sons of Seir Lotan Shobal Zibeon Anah Dishon Ezer and Dishan
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Seir: Lotã, Sobal, Zibeão, Aná, Diso, Ezer e Disã.

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֥י לוֹטָ֖ן חֹרִ֣י וְהוֹמָ֑ם וַאֲח֥וֹת לוֹטָ֖ן תִּמְנָֽע׃ס
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê lō·w·ṭān ḥō·rî wə·hō·w·mām wa·’ă·ḥō·wṯ lō·w·ṭān tim·nā‘
verses.literal: The sons of Lotan Hori and Homam Timna was Lotan’s sister
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Lotã: Hori e Homã; e Timna era irmã de Lotã.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֣י שׁוֹבָ֔ל עַלְיָ֧ן וּמָנַ֛חַת וְעֵיבָ֖ל שְׁפִ֣י וְאוֹנָ֑םס וּבְנֵ֥י צִבְע֖וֹן אַיָּ֥ה וַעֲנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nê šō·w·ḇāl ‘al·yān ū·mā·na·ḥaṯ wə·‘ê·ḇāl šə·p̄î wə·ʾō·nå̄·ms ū·ḇə·nê ṣiḇ·‘ō·wn ’ay·yāh wa·‘ă·nāh
verses.literal: The sons of Shobal Alvan Manahath Ebal Shepho and Onam The sons of Zibeon Aiah and Anah
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Sobal: Aliã, Manaate, Ebal, Sefi e Onã. Os filhos de Zibeão: Aiá e Aná.

verses.original: בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָ֖ה דִּישׁ֑וֹןס וּבְנֵ֣י דִישׁ֔וֹן חַמְרָ֥ן וְאֶשְׁבָּ֖ן וְיִתְרָ֥ן וּכְרָֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: bə·nê ‘ă·nāh dī·šō·ns ū·ḇə·nê ḏî·šō·wn ḥam·rān wə·’eš·bān wə·yiṯ·rān ū·ḵə·rān
verses.literal: The son of Anah Dishon The sons of Dishon Hemdan Eshban Ithran and Cheran
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Aná: Disom. Os filhos de Disom: Hanrão, Esbã, Itrã e Querã.

verses.original: בְּֽנֵי־ אֵ֔צֶר בִּלְהָ֥ן וְזַעֲוָ֖ן יַעֲקָ֑ן בְּנֵ֥י דִישׁ֖וֹן ע֥וּץ וַאֲרָֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: bə·nê- ’ê·ṣer bil·hān wə·za·‘ă·wān ya·‘ă·qān bə·nê ḏî·šō·wn ‘ūṣ wa·’ă·rān
verses.literal: The sons of Ezer Bilhan Zaavan and Akan The sons of Dishan Uz and Aran
verses.literalPt: Os filhos de Eser: Bilã, Zaavã e Jaacã. Os filhos de Disã: Uz e Arã.

verses.original: וְאֵ֣לֶּה הַמְּלָכִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר מָלְכוּ֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אֱד֔וֹם לִפְנֵ֥י מְלָךְ־ מֶ֖לֶךְ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל בֶּ֚לַע בֶּן־ בְּע֔וֹר וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ דִּנְהָֽבָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh ham·mə·lā·ḵîm ’ă·šer mā·lə·ḵū bə·’e·reṣ ’ĕ·ḏō·wm lip̄·nê mə·lāḵ- me·leḵ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl be·la‘ ben- bə·‘ō·wr wə·šêm ‘î·rōw din·hā·ḇāh
verses.literal: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites . . . Bela son of Beor His city was named Dinhabah
verses.literalPt: Ora, estes são os reis que reinaram na terra de Edom, antes que reinasse rei sobre os filhos de Israel: Bela, filho de Beor; e a sua cidade chamava-se Dinabá.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מָת בָּ֑לַע וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו יוֹבָ֥ב בֶּן־ זֶ֖רַח מִבָּצְרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ bā·la‘ way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw yō·w·ḇāḇ ben- ze·raḥ mib·bā·ṣə·rāh
verses.literal: When Bela died Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Morreu Bela, e, em seu lugar, reinou Jobabe, filho de Zerá, de Bozra.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מָת יוֹבָ֑ב וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו חוּשָׁ֖ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ הַתֵּימָנִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ yō·w·ḇāḇ way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw ḥū·šām mê·’e·reṣ hat·tê·mā·nî
verses.literal: When Jobab died Husham from the land of the Temanites reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Morreu Jobabe, e, em seu lugar, reinou Husão, da terra dos temanitas.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מָת חוּשָׁ֑ם וַיִּמְלֹ֨ךְ תַּחְתָּ֜יו הֲדַ֣ד בֶּן־ בְּדַ֗ד הַמַּכֶּ֤ה אֶת־ מִדְיָן֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ׃ עֲיוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ ḥū·šām way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw hă·ḏaḏ ben- bə·ḏaḏ ham·mak·keh ’eṯ- miḏ·yān biś·ḏêh mō·w·’āḇ wə·šêm ‘î·rōw ʿă·yōṯ
verses.literal: When Husham died Hadad son of Bedad who defeated Midian in the country of Moab reigned in his place And the name of his city was Avith
verses.literalPt: Morreu Husão, e, em seu lugar, reinou Hadade, filho de Bedade, que derrotou a Midiã no campo de Moabe; e a sua cidade chamava-se Avite.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מָת הֲדָ֑ד וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שַׂמְלָ֖ה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ hă·ḏāḏ way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw śam·lāh mim·maś·rê·qāh
verses.literal: When Hadad died Samlah from Masrekah reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Morreu Hadade, e, em seu lugar, reinou Sanlá de Masreca.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מָת שַׂמְלָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו שָׁא֖וּל מֵרְחֹב֥וֹת הַנָּהָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ śam·lāh way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw šā·’ūl mê·rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ han·nā·hār
verses.literal: When Samlah died Shaul from Rehoboth on the Euphrates reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Morreu Sanlá, e, em seu lugar, reinou Saul de Reobote junto ao rio.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מָת שָׁא֑וּל וַיִּמְלֹ֣ךְ תַּחְתָּ֔יו בַּ֥עַל חָנָ֖ן בֶּן־ עַכְבּֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ šā·’ūl way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw ba·‘al ḥā·nān ben- ‘aḵ·bō·wr
verses.literal: When Shaul died Baal-hanan son of Achbor reigned in his place
verses.literalPt: Morreu Saul, e, em seu lugar, reinou Baal-Hanã, filho de Acbor.

verses.original: וַיָּ֙מָת֙ בַּ֣עַל חָנָ֔ן וַיִּמְלֹ֤ךְ תַּחְתָּיו֙ הֲדַ֔ד וְשֵׁ֥ם עִיר֖וֹ פָּ֑עִי וְשֵׁ֨ם אִשְׁתּ֤וֹ מְהֵיטַבְאֵל֙ בַּת־ מַטְרֵ֔ד בַּ֖ת מֵ֥י זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ ba·‘al ḥā·nān way·yim·lōḵ taḥ·tāw hă·ḏaḏ wə·šêm ‘î·rōw pā·‘î wə·šêm ’iš·tōw mə·hê·ṭaḇ·’êl baṯ- maṭ·rêḏ baṯ mê zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: When Baal-hanan died Hadad reigned in his place His city was named Pau and his wife’s name was Mehetabel daughter of Matred the daughter of Me-zahab
verses.literalPt: Morreu Baal-Hanã, e, em seu lugar, reinou Hadade; e a sua cidade chamava-se Paí. O nome de sua mulher era Meetabel, filha de Matrede, filha de Me-Zaabe.

verses.original: וַיָּ֖מָת הֲדָ֑דס וַיִּהְיוּ֙ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם אַלּ֥וּף תִּמְנָ֛ע אַלּ֥וּף עַלְיָה אַלּ֥וּף יְתֵֽת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ hă·ḏå̄·ḏs way·yih·yū ’al·lū·p̄ê ’ĕ·ḏō·wm ’al·lūp̄ tim·nā‘ ’al·lūp̄ ʿal·yå̄h ’al·lūp̄ yə·ṯêṯ
verses.literal: Then Hadad . . . died Now the chiefs of Edom were . . . Timna . . . Alvah . . . Jetheth
verses.literalPt: Hadade morreu. Os príncipes de Edom foram: o príncipe Timna, o príncipe Aliá, o príncipe Jetete,

verses.original: אַלּ֧וּף אָהֳלִיבָמָ֛ה אַלּ֥וּף אֵלָ֖ה אַלּ֥וּף פִּינֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ’al·lūp̄ ’ā·ho·lî·ḇā·māh ’al·lūp̄ ’ê·lāh ’al·lūp̄ pî·nōn
verses.literal: Oholibamah . . . Elah . . . Pinon
verses.literalPt: o príncipe Oolibama, o príncipe Elá, o príncipe Pinom,

verses.original: אַלּ֥וּף קְנַ֛ז אַלּ֥וּף תֵּימָ֖ן אַלּ֣וּף מִבְצָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’al·lūp̄ qə·naz ’al·lūp̄ tê·mān ’al·lūp̄ miḇ·ṣār
verses.literal: Kenaz . . . Teman . . . Mibzar
verses.literalPt: o príncipe Quenaz, o príncipe Temã, o príncipe Mibzar,

verses.original: אַלּ֥וּף מַגְדִּיאֵ֖ל אַלּ֣וּף עִירָ֑ם אֵ֖לֶּה אַלּוּפֵ֥י אֱדֽוֹם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’al·lūp̄ maḡ·dî·’êl ’al·lūp̄ ‘î·rām ’êl·leh ’al·lū·p̄ê ’ĕ·ḏō·wm
verses.literal: Magdiel . . . and Iram These were the chiefs of Edom
verses.literalPt: o príncipe Magdiel e o príncipe Irã. Estes são os príncipes de Edom.
